description:
> *Generated by AI from docs/research/c-verification-macos.md.*

Tools that check the C defk emits for memory errors (overflows, use-after-free, uninitialised reads, leaks) and the compiler's elided-check proofs. Findings and exact commands: docs/research/c-verification-macos.md.

Policy (maintainer, 2026-10-13): NOT part of every CI build (mix ci). They run as part of a release build, and each can be run on demand as its own task.

comments.text: Plan (maintainer, 2026-10-13): zero-bug policy first — defk-bh3 lands before the epic (96f.3 depends on it: the Valgrind runner must not hit multi-GiB agreement cases). Then 96f.1 (sanitizer mode) and 96f.3 (Valgrind container) in parallel. Then 96f.4/.5/.6 (at most 3 agents), then 96f.2 (mix defk.verify + release alias).

title: Verification of generated C: release-time and on-demand checks (sanitizers, Valgrind, fuzzing, bounded proofs)
